correctness.rationale: With Q=[[-a,a],[b,-b]], pi=(b,a)/(a+b), centered velocity diagonal (-a Δ/r,b Δ/r), the exact 2x2 Laplace resolvent is (s+r-ηΔz)/(s(s+r-ηΔz)-PΔ²z²). Expansion through z⁴ and inversion give κ4=24PΔ⁴/r⁴[η²A(rt)-PB(rt)]. The explicit A and B both vanish with first derivatives at 0, their second derivatives are positive and B″/A″=4(u-1+exp(-u))/u² strictly decreases. Two monotone weighted-average steps establish B/A decreases strictly from 2 to 1. With P=(1-η²)/4 this gives the exact 1/5 and 1/3 thresholds, a unique simple interior crossing in the middle regime, and strict signs on both boundaries. The Feynman-Kac 10x10 moment block implementation checked 333 assertions with maximum matrix discrepancy about 2.73e-12; this is supplementary, not an infinite proof. Independent Gaussian increments have zero fourth cumulant. All parameters a,b,Δ strictly positive and t>0; no hidden normalization assumptions.

originality.rationale: The exact two-rate telegraph process and arbitrary-order moment machinery are prior art, in particular López–Ratanov (2014), Theorem 4.1 and its closed general moments in Section 4. The claim is NOT priority to those formulas, but an all-time, sharp two-threshold sign trichotomy with strict unique zero and a monotone quotient proof. The examined primary full text does not assert the trichotomy or unique-crossing theorem, nor does the closest symmetric-moment abstract do so. Earlier nearby findings concern three-state rest dynamics, spatially periodic symmetric tumble rates, or randomized speed magnitude, and their hypotheses and implications do not yield this stationary asymmetric constant-velocity classification. Searches did not find equivalent results, but this does not prove global novelty. Historical priority should be independently checked.
residual_risks: General moments from López–Ratanov mathematically contain sufficient information to derive κ4, so originality is claimed solely for the sharpened all-time sign and uniqueness classification, not for the moment formula or physical model.
Other papers or theses might have independently analyzed the exact kurtosis sign inequality under occupation-time or random-telegraph terminology; finite searches cannot establish priority.
The Kolesnik (2012) full text was not accessed after a bounded retrieval timeout, though its cited symmetric model does not cover switching asymmetry.
The focal bibliographic catalog gives an exact 2014-07-11 date, but the journal issue is identified only by month June 2014, leaving the earliest actual day of public availability uncertain.

value.rationale: Anomalous (negative versus positive) fourth cumulant of a transport displacement is a natural measure of non-Gaussian transient transport. Existing asymmetric telegraph moments alone do not tell whether temporal sign reversal can happen, how many times, or which imbalance produces it. The new exact 1/5 and 1/3 thresholds classify every positive time, prove a unique transition in the intermediate regime, and persist under ordinary independent thermal Brownian broadening. This is a structural all-parameter, all-time theorem with a measurable implication, not a single arbitrary numerical slice. The result is restricted to stationary two-state Markov velocity transport and does not claim a broader universality class.
